title: Which Vegetables Can Beat an Egg in Protein? The Honest Answer With Real Numbers
seoTitle: Which Vegetables Beat an Egg in Protein? Real Numbers
seoDescription: A large egg has about 6.3 g protein. Few vegetables match it gram for gram; see USDA figures for edamame, peas, moringa, dal, tofu and more.
excerpt: Compares the protein in an egg with plant foods such as tempeh, lentils, chickpeas, tofu and quinoa, noting which are complete proteins and how to use them in everyday meals.
